objective: Restore existing protected Core and connect one meaningful owner-confirmed C0 Knowledge correction to retained-work reassessment and resumable proposed site review; expose accurately labeled development inquiry outcomes.

hosting.change: Replace only this protected build using complete matching rollback; start only the existing exact PM2 entry and save only the verified acceptance-account list. Stop if any additional application/identity or changed prerequisite appears.
hosting.publicBaselineCaveat: Fresh read-only baselines for eventual before/after checks; not an independently established historical byte-for-byte comparison.

database.ownerProcedure: Existing migration role through owner-entered hidden prompt; no new credential or password retention. Verify database/TLS, exact inactive binding, installed guard/constraint/grant metadata and lock availability before one guarded transaction. Save recovery definition/ACLs and enrollment receipt privately before changing anything.
database.rollback: Withdraw new access and restore matching old build/view; revoke only newly enrolled grants by receipt. Retain canonical/history/outcome/grant audit rows. Never erase or rewind facts/history.

customerMandate.authorityReference: Owner approval of this exact account-cycle scope

identity.limits: Only the existing C0 inactive binding/Knowledge record and development outcomes. Confirmation requires explicit UI attestation and exact current version/fingerprint. No automatic confirmation of retained ten answers; no customer acceptance/publication permission.
identity.permissionLifetime: Existing owner credential lifetime, exact C0 scope, revocable; no extra login. The 72-hour limit applies to AI execution, not forced expiry of owner review access.

data.newInputRule: Only one meaningful correction explicitly confirmed by the existing owner in Core to the exact existing Knowledge record, preserving classification, plus its server-derived prior report/Direction/plan/Pages and source relationships. Immediately before dispatch, validate the stored canonical receipt and bind exact reassessment and added-evidence hashes in a fresh private grant. Those exact bytes are not known at proposal time. This is a scoped session authorization proposal, not a claim that unknown text was already inspected. No invented correction merely to trigger AI.
excluded: operator/customer authority metadata in model projection
data.trustBoundary: Existing Core account only. No new protected input transfer to another account. Keep full approved originals; do not narrow silently. Stop if the meaningful correction requires an unlisted source or broader authority.

provider.research: Reuse retained permitted evidence; no new paid tools, image acquisition or expanded external research.
provider.budgetRationale: Representative targeted correction cycle of report, Direction, full-site plan, affected Page drafts and editorial review: 8 generations at illustrative 35k input + 8k output average cost $1.66. This is an estimate, not measured future usage. Worst per-dispatch input/output reservation is $0.485760. Existing meter must reserve within $3 before any generation and refuse if insufficient; budget may halt a larger revision. No Page-count cap or truncation to fit a demo. Recover retained output before considering any further paid request.
provider.ledger: New existing-format core-account-cycle-usage directory and account-cycle-workflow-grant.json, with historical ledger/hash references preserved. No old ledger reset, grant reuse or transfer of old approvals.
provider.ordinaryCorrections: Tested purpose-bound code/config fixes may proceed within this exact scope with checksums/evidence and unchanged aggregate ceiling; broader data, spending, authority or protected WordPress application requires its own decision.

acceptance: Authenticated external Core sign-in/read/logout using existing owner access; existing drafts remain available.
Actual owner-confirmed correction and canonical/workflow receipts survive reload; unrelated knowledge remains unchanged.

Real model output explains the business consequence, retains useful prior work and produces editable affected site work with before/after evidence. No fixture or technical validity claim as commercial acceptance.
Retained response recovery, metering and visible refusal work without blind regeneration.
Development outcomes remain labeled, notifications/visitor collection/revision attribution remain unknown unless implemented and verified. No fabricated business performance.
remainingGaps: This prepares a bounded account connection; independent versioned proposal storage and full Offering editing remain open.

Explicit association of the separate isolated evaluation106, ordinary active-site inquiry/notification, installation-bound visitor measurement and WP inbound reconciliation remain separate unfinished work.
No new whole-site creative/design-quality acceptance or new WordPress candidate is claimed.
